comparison_rules: Only seed changes between original and replicated versions of each arm.
Same data and optimizer draws within each pair; position exposure totals can differ across seeds and must be reported.
Seed-2 common initial weights must agree across its pair and differ from seed 1.
execution: Sequential fresh control, then fresh spatial candidate; each 1024 updates at peak LR 1e-3. No warm start.
interpretation: A lower candidate KL in this second seed replicates the direction. Report both effect sizes; two seeds are insufficient to establish precise statistical confidence. Do not select the better seed.
next: Review both seeds and pass diagnostics before choosing the next encoder/rollout intervention.
primary: Candidate minus control full-validation KL at update 1024, with matched actual samples within this new seed.
qualification: Reuse passed unchanged numerical graphs and full shapes; independent finite-update, sample, initial common-weight and trained-cache audits still required.
